steps.input:
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in I for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(I,bg)
    big=max(comps,key=len)
    rs=[c[0] for c in big]; cs_=[c[1] for c in big]
    rmin,cmin=min(rs),min(cs_)
    sh=[(a-rmin,b-cmin,I[a][b]) for a,b in big]
    twrel=(max(a-rmin for a,b in [(aa-rmin,bb-cmin) for aa,bb in big]))  # placeholder
    twr=[(a-rmin,b-cmin) for a,b in big if I[a][b]==2]
    singles=sorted([(list(c)[0][0],list(c)[0][1]) for c in comps if len(c)==1 and I[list(c)[0][0]][list(c)[0][1]]==2])
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    tr=twr[0]
    top=lambda r0,c0:(r0-tr[0],c0-tr[1])
    for (r0,c0) in singles:
        t=top(r0,c0)
        for a,b,vv in sh:
            ra,ca=t[0]+a,t[1]+b
            if 0<=ra<H and 0<=ca<W and vv!=bg: out[ra][ca]=vv
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I,O=G[name+' input'],G[name+' output']
    R=solve(I)
    diff=[(a,b,R[a][b],O[a][b]) for a in range(len(R)) for b in range(len(R[0])) if R[a][b]!=O[a][b]]
    print(name,'match:',R==O,'ndiff',len(diff),diff[:6])

def components(cells):
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for c in sorted(cells):
        if c in seen: continue
        q=[c]; comp=[c]; seen.add(c)
        while q:
            x,y=q.pop()
            for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                if (a,b) not in seen and (a,b) in cells:

from collections import Counter
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
gi,go=G['Demo pair 6 input'],G['Demo pair 6 output']
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
cols=[c for c in cnt if c!=bgv]; noise=max(cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
shcells=set((p,q) for p in range(H) for q in range(W) if gi[p][q]!=bgv and gi[p][q]!=noise)
reds=sorted((p,q) for p in range(H) for q in range(W) if gi[p][q]==noise)
added=set((p,q) for p in range(H) for q in range(W) if go[p][q]!=bgv and gi[p][q]==bgv)
# symmetry group of shape: rotations+reflections (8 dihedral), normalized to origin
def d8(cells):
    res=[]
    pts=list(cells)
    for _ in range(4):
        res.append(frozenset(pts))
        res.append(frozenset({(-a,b) for a,b in pts}))
        pts=[(b,-a) for a,b in pts]
    return set(res)
S=d8(shcells)
print('sym sizes',set(len(s) for s in S),'n',len(S))
def fits(tv,added,excluded=set()):
    # translation of tv whose cells all lie in added
    cands=[]
    p0,minp=min(a for a,_ in tv); q0=min(b for _,b in tv)
    for dp in range(-(W-1-p0), H):
        for dq in range(-(W-1-q0), W):
            s={(a+dp,b+dq) for a,b in tv}
            if all(0<=a<H and 0<=b<W for a,b in s) and s<=added and not s & excluded:
                cands.append((abs(dp)+abs(dq),dp,dq,s))
    return cands
for ti,tv in enumerate(sorted(S,key=len)):
    c=fits(tv,added,shcells|{(p,q) for p,q in reds})
    c.sort(key=lambda x:x[0])
    print('Ti',ti,'sz',len(tv),'anchors:',[(x[0],x[1],x[2]) for x in c][:5])

G2={}
import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G2 and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G2[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G2))
for name in ['Demo pair 7']:
    gi,go=G2[name+' input'],G2[name+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=[c for c in cnt if c!=bgv]; noise=max(cols,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    diff=[(p,q,gi[p][q],go[p][q]) for p in range(H) for q in range(W) if gi[p][q]!=go[p][q]]
    print('---',name,'bg',bgv,'noise',noise,'H,W',H,W)
    for p,q,a,b in diff:
        print(f'  {a}->{b} at ({p},{q})')

# Hypothesis H: every singleton marker (non-bg singleton) anchors a vertically-flipped copy of the shape,
# positioned so that the shape's uniquely-colored cell (the singleton color) lands on the marker.
def analyze(name):
    gi,go=G[name+' input'],G[name+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=components(gi,bgv)
    singles={next(iter(c)) for c in comps if len(c)==1}
    big=max(comps,key=len)
    marks=sorted(singles-big)
    shape=[(p,q,gi[p][q]) for p,q in big]
    # uniquely colored cell in shape (relative)
    from collections import defaultdict
    cc=defaultdict(list)
    for p,q,v in shape: cc[v].append((p,q))
    print('---',name,'marks:',marks)
    for m in marks:
        mv=gi[m[0]][m[1]]
        ucells=[(pr,qr) for v2,lst in cc.items() if v2==mv and len(lst)==1 for pr,qr in lst]
        urel=tuple(sorted((pr-min(p for p,_ in shape),qr-min(q for _,q in shape)) for pr,qr in ucells))[0]
        urel=tuple(sorted([(min(a for a,_ in shape)-pr if False else 0,0)]))
        urel=tuple(sorted(set((p-min(p for p,q in shape), q-min(q for q2,q in shape)) for p,q in ucells)))
        urel=(min(p for p,_ in ucells)-min(p for p,_ in shape), min(q for _,q in ucells)-min(q for _,q in shape))
        # find flips of shape whose uniquely colored cell maps onto marker
        res=[]
        for s in S:
            sn=s
            for dp in range(-H,H+1):
                for dq in range(-W,W+1):
                    s2={(a+dp,b+dq) for a,b in sn}
                    if not s2<=added|big|{m}: continue
                    # check mapped color match: every shape cell color == go color at target
                    ok=True
                    for pr,qr,vv in shape:
                        tr,tc=pr+dp,qr+dq
                        if 0<=tr<H and 0<=tc<W:
                            if go[tr][tc]!=vv and (tr,tc) not in added|big: ok=False;break
                    if ok:
                        res.append((dp,dq,s2))
        print('  mark',m,'ucell rel',urel,'nvalid',len(res),'first',res[0][:2] if res else None)

                        if 0<=na<H and 0<=nb<W and g[na][nb]!=bgv and (na,nb) not in c:

def d8norm(cells):
    def norm(t):
        mr=min(a for a,b,v in t); mc=min(b for _,b,_ in t)
        return tuple(sorted((a-mr,b-mc,v) for a,b,v in t))
    cur=[(a,b,v) for a,b,v in cells]
    outs=set()
    for flip in (False,True):
        for r in range(4):
            if flip: cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            else: cur=[(-a,b,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            for _ in range(r): cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            outs.add(norm(cur))
    return sorted(outs)

def d8norm(cells):
    cur=[(a,b,v) for a,b,v in cells]
    outs=set()
    for flip in (False,True):
        for r in range(4):
            if flip: cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            else: cur=[(-a,b,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            for _ in range(r): cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
            mr=min(a for a,b,v in cur); mc=min(b for _,b,_ in cur)
            outs.add(tuple(sorted((a-mr,b-mc,v) for a,b,v in cur)))
    return sorted(outs)
def solve6(gi,verbose=False):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps_g(gi,bgv)
    objs=[[(p,q,v) for p,q,v in c] for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    singles=[next(iter(c)) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    go=[[x for x in r] for r in gi]
    painted=[]  # list of cells (x,y) stamped so far (overwritten by any color stamp; priority: original marker preserved anyway)
    for m in sorted(singles):
        mv=gi[m[0]][m[1]]
        best=None
        for o in objs:
            for T in d8norm(o):
                for tcell in [(t[0],t[1],v) for t,v in [] ]: pass
                # anchor: find cell of T with same color as marker? not needed—anchor arbitrary; search all translations
                tcells=[(x,y,v) for x,y,v in T]
                for tx,ty,tv in tcells:
                    dp=m[0]-tx; dq=m[1]-ty
                    s=[(dp+x,dq+y,v) for x,y,v in T]
                    if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) for x,y,v in s): continue
                    nbg=sum(1 for x,y,v in s if go[x][y]==bgv)
                    dd=sum(abs(x-m[0])+abs(y-m[1]) for x,y,v in s)/len(s)
                    key=(nbg,-dd)
                    if best is None or key>best[0]: best=key,s
        if best is None: continue
        for x,y,v in best[1]:
            if go[x][y]==bgv: go[x][y]=v
            elif go[x][y]==mv and x==m[0] and y==m[1]: pass
    return go
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    print(n, solve6(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])

def comps_nonbg(g):

    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H_):
        for j in range(W_):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; comp=[]
                while st:
                    p,q=st.pop()
                    if (p,q) in seen or g[p][q]==bg: continue
                    seen.add((p,q)); comp.append((p,q,g[p][q]))
                    nb=[(p+dx,q+dy) for dx in(-1,0,1) for dy in(-1,0,1) if (p+dx,q+dy) not in seen and 0<=p+dx<H_ and 0<=q+dy<W_]
                    st.extend(nb)
                out.append(comp)
    return out,bg

def diffcount(n):
    gi,go=G[n+' input'],G[n+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r); bgv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(gi,bgv)
    objs=[norm(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]
    singles=[next(iter(c)) for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    g2=[r[:] for r in go]
    for m in sorted(singles):
        mv=gi[m[0]][m[1]]
        ok=[]
        for T in objs:
            maxa=max(a for a,b,v in T); maxb=max(b for _,b,_ in T)
            for tx in range(H-maxa):
                for ty in range(W-maxb):
                    cells=[(tx+a,ty+b,v) for a,b,v in T]
                    if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) for x,y,v in cells) or any(g2[x][y]!=bgv and g2[x][y]!=mv for x,y,v in cells): continue
                    ok.append((sum(1 for x,y,v in cells if g2[x][y]==bgv),cells))
        ok.sort(key=lambda k:(-k[0],sum(abs(x-m[0])+abs(y-m[1]) for x,y,v in k[1])))
        for x,y,v in ok[0][1]:
            if g2[x][y]==bgv: g2[x][y]=v
    return sum(1 for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if g2[a][b]!=go[a][b]),g2
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    dc,g2=diffcount(n)
    print(n,'ndiff',dc)

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])

def solve_pair(n):
    gi=G[n+' input']; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps2(gi,bgv)
    obj=max(cs,key=len)
    acnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in obj)
    anchor=[cell for cell in obj if acnt[cell[2]]==1][0]
    sh=[(x-anchor[0],y-anchor[1],v) for x,y,v in obj if v!=anchor[2]]
    # try mirror variants and choose best
    def d8(cells):
        cur=list(cells); res=[]
        for _ in range(4):
            mr=min(a for a,b,_ in cur); mc=min(b for _,b,_ in cur)
            T=tuple(sorted((a-mr,b-mc,v) for a,b,v in cur)); res.append(T)
            cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        return sorted(set(res))
    Ts=d8(sh)
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    singles=[(a,b,gi[a][b]) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if gi[a][b]==2]
    painted=set()
    for ma,mb,mv in singles:
        best=None
        for T in Ts:
            anchors=[a0 for a0,b0,V0 in T if V0==mv]
            for a0,b0 in anchors:
                ts=[(ma-a0+a,mb-b0+b,V) for a,b,V in T]
                if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or g[x][y]!=bgv for x,y,V in ts): continue
                ds=sum(abs(x-ma)+abs(y-mb) for x,y,V in ts)
                if best is None or (-ds)>best[0]: best=(-ds,ts)
        if not best: continue
        for x,y,V in best[1]:
            if g[x][y]==bgv: g[x][y]=V; painted.add((x,y))
    return g
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    r=solve_pair(n)
    diffs=[(a,b,G[n+' output'][a][b],r[a][b]) for a in range(len(r)) for b in range(len(r[0])) if r[a][b]!=G[n+' output'][a][b]]
    print(n,'ndiff',len(diffs),diffs[:6])

def solve_pair(n):
    gi=G[n+' input']; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps2(gi,bgv)
    src=None
    for c in cs:
        if len(c)>1:
            cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in c)
            if len(cnt)>1 and max(cnt.values())==1: src=c; break
    anchor=[cell for cell in src if Counter(v for _,_,v in src)[cell[2]]==1][0]
    acolor=anchor[2]
    sh=[(x-anchor[0],y-anchor[1],v) for x,y,v in src if v!=acolor]
    # d8 rotations only (no flips? try both later) - shape as rel offsets with values; also mirror? shapes asymmetric usually -> no mirror. Use rotations only, but check flip separately.
    def rots(cells):
        cur=list(cells); res=[]
        for _ in range(4):
            mr=min(a for a,b,_ in cur); mc=min(b for _,b,_ in cur)
            T=tuple(sorted((a-mr,b-mc,v) for a,b,v in cur)); res.append(T)
            cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        return sorted(set(res))
    Ts=rots(sh)
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    twos=[(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if gi[a][b]==2]

        opts=[]
        for i,T in enumerate(Ts):

                ts=[(ma-a0+a,mb-b0+b,V) for a,b,V in T]
                if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) for x,y,V in ts): continue
                if any((x,y) in painted for x,y,V in [(x,y,V) for x,y,V in ts]): continue

        _,i,a0,b0,ts=max(opts)
        for x,y,V in ts:
            if g[x][y]==bgv: g[x][y]=V; painted.add((x,y))
    return g

def solve_pair(n, flip_allowed=False):
    gi=G[n+' input']; go=None
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bgv=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps2(gi,bgv)
    src=None
    for c in cs:
        cnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in c)
        if max(cnt.values())>1 and len(cnt)>1: src=c; break
    acnt=Counter(v for _,_,v in src); anchor=[cell for cell in src if acnt[cell[2]]==1][0]
    acolor=anchor[2]
    sh=[(x-anchor[0],y-anchor[1],v) for x,y,v in src if v!=acolor]
    # d8 transforms including optional horizontal flip
    def rots(cells,flip):
        cur=list(cells)
        if flip: cur=[(a,-b,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        res=[]
        for _ in range(4):
            mr=min(a for a,b,_ in cur); mc=min(b for _,b,_ in cur)
            T=tuple(sorted((a-mr,b-mc,v) for a,b,v in cur)); res.append(T)
            cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        return sorted(set(res))
    Ts=rots(sh,flip_allowed)
    g=[r[:] for r in gi]
    twos=sorted([(a,b) for a in range(H) for b in range(W) if gi[a][b]==2])
    painted=set()
    for ma,mb in twos:
        opts=[]
        for i,T in enumerate(Ts):
            for a0,b0,V0 in T:
                ts=[(ma-a0+a,mb-b0+b,V) for a,b,V in T]
                if any(not(0<=x<H and 0<=y<W) or g[x][y]!=bgv and g[x][y]!=V and g[x][y]!=go and (x,y) in painted for x,y,V in [(x,y,V) for x,y,V in ts]): continue
                ds=sum(abs(x-ma)+abs(y-mb) for x,y,V in ts)
                opts.append((-ds,i,a0,b0,ts))
        if not opts: continue
        _,i,a0,b0,ts=max(opts)
        for x,y,V in ts:
            if g[x][y]==bgv: g[x][y]=V; painted.add((x,y))
    return g,painted,Ts
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    r,painted,Ts=solve_pair(n)
    diffs=[(a,b,G[n+' output'][a][b],r[a][b]) for a in range(len(r)) for b in range(len(r[0])) if r[a][b]!=G[n+' output'][a][b]]
    print(n,'ndiff',len(diffs),diffs[:6],'Tcount',len(Ts),'Ts',Ts[:2])

def diheds(P):
    outs=[]
    cur=P
    for k in range(4):
        # rotation 90: (a,b)->(b,-a)
        cur=[(b,-a,v) for a,b,v in cur]
        outs.append(tuple(sorted(cur)))
        # flip
        outs.append(tuple(sorted((a,-b,v) for a,b,v in cur)))
